activeSlice.scope: Diagnose and recover operational Hunter V2 deep analysis on the read-only shadow lane. Retry only transient model failures once; expose bounded failure-kind counts; mark the candidate failed when every requested deep analysis fails. Keep V1 authority, source budgets, scoring rubric and rollout thresholds unchanged.
successCriteria: A transient rate limit or timeout receives one bounded retry without changing the candidate or model-work profile.
Deep analysis successes and bounded failure categories appear in read-only benchmark evidence without raw model error text.
A candidate whose every requested deep analysis fails is measured as a V2 failure.
No quality-delta, retrieval, failure, latency, cost, exploration or topic-share rollout threshold changes.
V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary, scheduler or production enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass; rerun 3x3 on exact merge SHA before any 30-pair gate.

priorPreGateEvidence.reason: R produced timely subjects but lower quality. All 52 selected items had one source and none had a proposed deep angle; model failures were swallowed and V2 failure rate reported zero. Cohort included two Vercel contexts, so direct Q-versus-R quality comparison is not valid.
